skill_creation_review.existing_skill_review: Reviewed current skills and modules before adding issue-governance: ai-coding-agent-rules for baseline repo execution and portable playbooks, context-preserving-ai-publisher for generated-surface discipline, project-completion-audit for final readiness audits, toolkit-setup for toolkit plugin setup, README skill tables, toolkit skill routing source, and the skill safety matrix. No existing skill owns the global issue-governance standard, lean-parent/comprehensive-child templates, local snapshot schema, or deterministic advisory audit.
skill_creation_review.trigger: Use issue-governance when the task involves issue governance policy, issue templates, parent/child tracker structure, reconciliation timestamps, controller-vs-implementer authority, governance modes, issue snapshot validation, or advisory audits. Do not use it for ordinary issue triage, live issue mutation, or GitHub API writes.
skill_creation_review.decision_reason: The trigger is a global governance standard with policy metadata, templates, schema, and audit logic. It has a distinct trigger, safety boundary, and validation path that does not fit any existing skill.
skill_creation_review.unique_value: Provides the canonical Toolkit issue-governance policy, machine-readable templates, deterministic snapshot schema, stable finding codes, and read-only advisory audit for governed repositories.
skill_creation_review.runtime_footprint: SKILL.md stays instruction-only and compact. Policy, templates, and schema are loaded on demand. No heavy runtime dependencies.
skill_creation_review.local_assets: Policy JSON, templates, snapshot schema, and audit documentation. No external dependencies.
skill_creation_review.output_contract: Return a structured advisory audit with stable finding codes, human-readable or JSON output, and explicit exit codes.
skill_creation_review.anti_bloat_review: The skill is focused on governance policy and audit. It does not contain generic issue-triage advice or model-common knowledge.
skill_creation_review.safety_boundary: Read-only audit only. Never mutates issues, ticks checkboxes, closes/reopens issues, or writes to GitHub. No credentials or network access required.
skill_creation_review.third_party_audit: not_applicable_first_party; no third-party text, scanner output, browser artifacts, code, or vendor docs copied or adapted.
skill_creation_review.publisher_workflow: context-preserving-ai-publisher source-to-surface workflow with first-party _main source, curated skill outputs, deterministic copy outputs, toolkit skill routing update, README table update, safety matrix update, sync, and validation.
skill_creation_review.routing: issue-governance is routed for issue governance policy, issue templates, parent/child tracker structure, reconciliation timestamps, controller-vs-implementer authority, governance modes, issue snapshot validation, and advisory audits. It is intentionally not routed for ordinary issue triage or live GitHub mutation.
